1	export function parse(input: string): string[][] {
2	  const rows: string[][] = []
3	  let row: string[] = []
4	  let field = ''
5	  let inQuotes = false
6	  let fieldStarted = false
7	  let i = 0
8	
9	  while (i < input.length) {
10	    const char = input[i]
11	
12	    if (inQuotes) {
13	      if (char === '"') {
14	        if (input[i + 1] === '"') {
15	          field += '"'
16	          i += 2
17	          continue
18	        }
19	        inQuotes = false
20	        i++
21	        continue
22	      }
23	      field += char
24	      i++
25	      continue
26	    }
27	
28	    if (char === '"') {
29	      inQuotes = true
30	      fieldStarted = true
31	      i++
32	      continue
33	    }
34	
35	    if (char === ',') {
36	      row.push(field)
37	      field = ''
38	      fieldStarted = true
39	      i++
40	      continue
41	    }
42	
43	    if (char === '\n') {
44	      row.push(field)
45	      rows.push(row)
46	      row = []
47	      field = ''
48	      fieldStarted = false
49	      i++
50	      continue
51	    }
52	
53	    field += char
54	    fieldStarted = true
55	    i++
56	  }
57	
58	  if (fieldStarted || field.length > 0) {
59	    row.push(field)
60	    rows.push(row)
61	  }
62	
63	  return rows
64	}
65

1	import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
2	import { parse } from '../src/parse'
3	
4	describe('parse', () => {
5	  it('parses a single row of plain fields', () => {
6	    expect(parse('a,b,c')).toEqual([['a', 'b', 'c']])
7	  })
8	
9	  it('parses multiple rows separated by newlines', () => {
10	    expect(parse('a,b,c\n1,2,3')).toEqual([
11	      ['a', 'b', 'c'],
12	      ['1', '2', '3'],
13	    ])
14	  })
15	
16	  it('treats commas inside quoted fields as literal characters', () => {
17	    expect(parse('name,quote\nAlice,"hello, world"')).toEqual([
18	      ['name', 'quote'],
19	      ['Alice', 'hello, world'],
20	    ])
21	  })
22	
23	  it('handles escaped double quotes inside quoted fields', () => {
24	    expect(parse('id,note\n1,"she said ""hi"""')).toEqual([
25	      ['id', 'note'],
26	      ['1', 'she said "hi"'],
27	    ])
28	  })
29	
30	  it('preserves newlines inside quoted fields', () => {
31	    expect(parse('id,bio\n1,"line one\nline two"')).toEqual([
32	      ['id', 'bio'],
33	      ['1', 'line one\nline two'],
34	    ])
35	  })
36	
37	  it('returns an empty array for empty input', () => {
38	    expect(parse('')).toEqual([])
39	  })
40	
41	  it('parses a single field', () => {
42	    expect(parse('hello')).toEqual([['hello']])
43	  })
44	
45	  it('handles empty fields between commas', () => {
46	    expect(parse('a,,b')).toEqual([['a', '', 'b']])
47	  })
48	
49	  it('handles leading and trailing empty fields', () => {
50	    expect(parse(',a,')).toEqual([['', 'a', '']])
51	  })
52	
53	  it('handles a trailing newline by not producing a phantom empty row', () => {
54	    expect(parse('a,b\n1,2\n')).toEqual([
55	      ['a', 'b'],
56	      ['1', '2'],
57	    ])
58	  })
59	
60	  it('parses an empty quoted field', () => {
61	    expect(parse('a,"",b')).toEqual([['a', '', 'b']])
62	  })
63	
64	  it('parses a quoted field containing only an escaped quote', () => {
65	    expect(parse('"""""')).toEqual([['""']])
66	  })
67	
68	  it('handles multiple quoted fields in one row', () => {
69	    expect(parse('"a","b,c","d"')).toEqual([['a', 'b,c', 'd']])
70	  })
71	
72	  it('handles mixed quoted and unquoted fields', () => {
73	    expect(parse('a,"b",c')).toEqual([['a', 'b', 'c']])
74	  })
75	
76	  it('handles multiple newlines inside a quoted field', () => {
77	    expect(parse('"a\n\nb"')).toEqual([['a\n\nb']])
78	  })
79	
80	  it('handles a row that consists only of an empty quoted field', () => {
81	    expect(parse('""')).toEqual([['']])
82	  })
83	})
